name: Shoulder range of motion
about: Highest arm elevation (degrees from hanging) reachable in each plane of elevation (0 = out to the side, 90 = straight forward, 130+ = across the body, negative = behind). Axial rotation range shrinks as the arm rises.
source: Approximate adult norms (AAOS; Soucie et al. 2011): flexion 180, abduction 180, extension 60, internal rotation 70, external rotation 90. Envelope shape is an approximation, editable.
